newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 17.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday April 17, 1997. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - The government plans to improve 128 km of road between Abidjan and Singrobo by June 1998, and to build a road from Singrobo to Taabo and an express road connecting Abidjan to Grand Bassam by June 1999. - The government has cut consumption taxes on a wide range of fuels, effective April 1. The tax on gasoil is cut to 49.2 francs a litre from 51.7 francs and on gasoline to 139 francs from 141.5 francs. - LA VOIE -Student crisis continues: the students' federation calls a five-day strike from Monday April 21 on every campus in Ivory Coast -The closing date for initial offers for the privatisation of sugar company Sodesucre is Monday April 21, 1997 at 1800 GMT. Another date will be set for final offers. LE JOUR -Managers of medium and small businesses say they would like to create a fund to provide medium- and long-term credit because banks, although they have adequate funds, are used to providing only short-term financing. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
